tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything, including the lidar field. Never pure white.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: The rare raised surface: article code blocks, the editor canvas, menus.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells: inputs, inline code, image placeholders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on paper, paper-raised and glass. 16.9:1 on paper (light), 15.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, descriptions, captions, nav at rest. 6.2:1 on paper (light), 7.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: lidar points at rest, disabled icons, the strong hairline. 3.2:1 on paper; never body text.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px rules between list rows and sections. Carries no meaning; pair with spacing.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Resting lidar dots in the far field. Atmosphere only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The scan laser. Links on hover, the active scanline, the one highlighted word. Text-safe on paper (4.6:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element. ≥5.3:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Body fill of the liquid glass material, over the refracted backdrop.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Specular rim highlight on the light-facing edge of glass.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Shadow-side inner edge of glass that separates it from the paper.

tokens.name: presence-1
tokens.usage: Visitor trail color 1 (vermilion). Trails and presence chips only.

tokens.name: presence-2
tokens.usage: Visitor trail color 2 (cobalt).

tokens.name: presence-3
tokens.usage: Visitor trail color 3 (teal).

tokens.name: presence-4
tokens.usage: Visitor trail color 4 (amber).

tokens.name: presence-5
tokens.usage: Visitor trail color 5 (violet).

tokens.name: presence-6
tokens.usage: Visitor trail color 6 (rose). All six hold ≥3.4:1 on paper as marks.

styles.name: display-name
styles.usage: The name header on the home page only. Scale to 56px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Creative developer working across AI, XR and the web.
styles.usage: UI copy, project descriptions, about text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Nav links, buttons, inline emphasis in UI.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: I built the controllers before I wrote a single line of the game.

styles.name: prose-lede
styles.sample: A rhythm game with arcade controllers I soldered myself.
styles.usage: The one-paragraph lede under an article title.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, tags, reading time, coordinates in the lidar overlay.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: presence count, section eyebrows. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code in articles.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, dot grid pitch at its densest.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Glass button padding (block), lidar dot pitch.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; glass button padding (inline).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between title and meta in a project row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; project row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs groups and figures in articles.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Top of the name header to the first section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, inline code, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Images and figures in articles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels: nav bar, editor toolbar, floating menus.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Glass buttons, presence chips.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Under every liquid glass surface. The only drop shadow in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything that is not glass: rows, images, the header. Paper is flat.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Frost behind glass, applied after refraction.

tokens.name: glass-refraction
tokens.usage: feDisplacementMap scale at the rim of a 28px-radius panel; scale with radius.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation boost so color under glass reads vivid, as Apple's material does.

meta.note: New direction for michal.us, derived from the repository itsMichal/space (logo, copy, project list) plus the 2026-10 overhaul brief: white paper theme, sans header, Apple-style liquid glass, multiplayer lidar trails.
